blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY, ORIENTAL MINDORO, Philippines — Two provincial most wanted persons and another wanted individual were arrested in separate police operations in Bongabong, Oriental Mindoro, on Wednesday, Sept. 16. Police identified the suspects as the provincial top 4 and top 5 most wanted persons, both arrested in Barangay San Jose, and another wanted person apprehended earlier in Barangay Aplaya. The operations were conducted by personnel from the Bongabong Municipal Police Station (MPS), 2nd Provincial Mobile Force Company (PMFC), and the Provincial Intelligence and Targeting Office of the Oriental Mindoro Police Provincial Office.
